propositions: The review-bot container needs IAM authorization to invoke Bedrock's Converse API via bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream actions scoped to Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles

The correct IAM actions are bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse), which was confirmed by real runtime calls from the instance rather than policy simulation alone
IMDS is reachable from review-bot containers on the host, allowing the instance role to supply short-lived credentials without modification to metadata_options
The policy must be added to a new infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf file following the established single-owner contract, leaving infra/terraform/iam.tf unchanged
Both wildcard regions and wildcard inference-profile prefixes in the resource ARN are load-bearing for cross-region routing and support for global.* profiles
